heading: Seller valuation
discard_dialog: Close and discard the unsaved changes?

errors.access: This valuation is unavailable for your account.
errors.freshness: Access and the current valuation could not be confirmed. Try again before making changes.
errors.conflict: The valuation has changed. Reload it and review the latest version before continuing.
errors.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Reload the valuation to check whether the change was saved.
errors.validation: Check the information you entered and try again.

subject.heading: Subject property
subject.help: Record the property facts and general location available for this valuation.
subject.save_before_next: Save the property facts before changing evidence or reviewing the report.

evidence.heading: Comparable evidence
evidence.intro: Capture asking prices from active listings and record closed sales from documents that establish the sale price and date.
evidence.confirm_remove: Remove this comparable from the valuation?
evidence.empty: There are no comparables in this valuation.

asking.help: Find active properties for sale. Adding one records the asking price at the time of capture.
asking.empty: No active sale listings match this search.

sold.help: Enter the sale price and date shown in the source. An evidence review is required before this sale counts as verified.
sold.label: Sold comparable
sold.review_verify_help: Confirm that the source identifies the property and establishes the recorded closing date and amount.
sold.review_reject_help: Record why the source does not establish the closing date or sale amount.

report.heading: Valuation report
report.empty: This valuation has no reviewed report yet.
report.expired: The property facts or comparable evidence have changed. Review the report again.
report.help: Explain the evidence used and the factors affecting the outcome.
report.range_needs_evidence: A price range requires a saved property type and location and at least one asking or verified sold comparable.
report.validation: Enter report notes. For a price range, choose a currency and an upper estimate at least as high as the lower estimate.

follow.heading: Follow-up
follow.help: Add an internal follow-up date and a note about the next step.
